schema.description: Machine-readable measured numbers for the self-PAM push-to-100% program. Follows the round-1 autopsy schema (push100/NUMBERS.json, schema v1): each round appends one entry under 'rounds' keyed by round slug (round numbers as strings; fix rounds use their slug, e.g. 'fix1'). Every measured number carries provenance: the repo-relative source file plus that file's git blob SHA-256 (git hash-object) at the commit the round was analyzed against. withhold_pct_x100 follows the instrument's own convention: withheld*10000/pairs_total (9158 = 91.58%, 10000 = 100.00%). Ledger entry format is 'e <idx> <jf> <jg> <0|1> <hash>' where the 5th whitespace-separated field is the admit(0)/withhold(1) flag and ledger idx = task_index*200 + pair_index with tasks [colordisc, colorconst, shapetrans, pitchdisc, timbredisc, motiondir]. mechanism_classes.*.verdict is MISS (genuine should-withhold miss) or CORRECT_ADMIT; fixed_by_* records the fix-round outcome per variant.

fields.rounds: object keyed by round slug; later rounds extend this object
fields.rounds.<slug>.admitted_ledger_indices: sorted list of ledger indices admitted by the primary variant
fields.rounds.<slug>.cross_checks: independent verification measurements (determinism, ledger chain verification, corpus manifest, toolchain pin, regression byte-identity)
fields.rounds.<slug>.mechanism_classes: autopsy taxonomy (from push100/round1): class id -> {name, count, tasks, verdict, fixable, information_theoretic, fixed_by_<variant>}
fields.rounds.<slug>.per_task: withheld/admitted counts per task for the primary variant
fields.rounds.<slug>.reference_gate: the reference (naive) gate's numbers for comparison
fields.rounds.<slug>.regression: misses fixed / remaining / regressions vs the round-1 autopsy regression list
fields.rounds.<slug>.variants: the measurement variants run this round (id -> numbers + provenance); 'baseline' selects the primary variant
